info.name: Vistona API
info.description: Tests real restaurant-owner signup, manager-issued staff access, role APIs, account management, existing ordering APIs, and payment endpoints. See postman/README.md for the run order. Uses Postman's HttpOnly cookie jar; no provider/database secrets are included.

item.name: 01 Authentication
item.description: Create a new restaurant manager first. Login sets an HttpOnly vistona_session cookie that Postman maintains for localhost.

exec: const stamp = Date.now();
pm.collectionVariables.set('managerEmail', `owner-${stamp}@example.test`);
pm.collectionVariables.set('managerPassword', 'VistonaOwner123!');
pm.collectionVariables.set('restaurantName', `Postman Bistro ${stamp}`);
pm.test('new owner and restaurant are created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('signup establishes manager session without returning a token', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('manager'); pm.expect(body.user.tenantId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.restaurantId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.token).to.eql(undefined); });

pm.test('signup sets HttpOnly session cookie', function () { const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(cookie).to.include('vistona_session='); pm.expect(cookie.toLowerCase()).to.include('httponly'); });
pm.test('login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns manager identity and no token body', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('manager'); pm.expect(body.user.tenantId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.restaurantId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.token).to.eql(undefined); });

pm.test('sets HttpOnly session cookie', function () { const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(cookie).to.include('vistona_session='); pm.expect(cookie.toLowerCase()).to.include('httponly'); });
pm.test('login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns waiter identity', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('waiter'); pm.expect(body.user.tenantId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.restaurantId).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('sets HttpOnly session cookie', function () { const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(cookie).to.include('vistona_session='); pm.expect(cookie.toLowerCase()).to.include('httponly'); });
pm.test('login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns kitchen identity', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.user.role).to.eql('kitchen'); pm.expect(body.user.tenantId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.user.restaurantId).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('sets HttpOnly session cookie', function () { const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(cookie).to.include('vistona_session='); pm.expect(cookie.toLowerCase()).to.include('httponly'); });
pm.test('session exists', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('session has role and tenant identity', function () { const user = pm.response.json().user; pm.expect(user.role).to.be.oneOf(['manager', 'waiter', 'kitchen']); pm.expect(user.tenantId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(user.restaurantId).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('logout succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().ok).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('expires session cookie', function () { const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(cookie).to.include('vistona_session='); pm.expect(cookie.toLowerCase()).to.include('max-age=0'); });

item.name: 02 Manager
item.description: After manager signup/login, read the new restaurant to capture database IDs.

exec: pm.test('manager can read restaurant', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('restaurant response includes database-backed tables and menu', function () { pm.expect(body.restaurant.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.tables).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.menu).to.be.an('array'); });
if (body.restaurant) pm.collectionVariables.set('restaurantSlug', body.restaurant.slug);

if (body.tables && body.tables.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('tableId', body.tables[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('tableNumber', body.tables[0].number); if (body.tables[0].publicQrToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('tableQrToken', body.tables[0].publicQrToken); }
if (body.menu && body.menu.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('menuItemId', body.menu[0].id);
pm.test('manager can update menu availability', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('response contains item availability', function () { const item = pm.response.json().item; pm.expect(item.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('menuItemId')); pm.expect(item.available).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 03 Staff Management
item.description: Manager-only staff CRUD and role-bound invitation tests. Run Create Manager and Restaurant and Login Manager first. Join with invite is last because it logs in as the invited user.

exec: pm.test('manager can list staff', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().staff).to.be.an('array'); });
const stamp = Date.now(); pm.collectionVariables.set('waiterEmail', `waiter-${stamp}@example.test`); pm.collectionVariables.set('waiterPassword', 'VistonaWaiter123!');

pm.test('manager creates a waiter in the current restaurant', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const staff = pm.response.json().staff; pm.expect(staff.role).to.eql('WAITER'); pm.expect(staff.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('waiterEmail')); pm.expect(staff.passwordHash).to.eql(undefined); if (staff.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('staffId', staff.id); });
const stamp = Date.now(); pm.collectionVariables.set('kitchenEmail', `kitchen-${stamp}@example.test`); pm.collectionVariables.set('kitchenPassword', 'VistonaKitchen123!');

pm.test('manager creates kitchen staff in the current restaurant', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const staff = pm.response.json().staff; pm.expect(staff.role).to.eql('KITCHEN'); pm.expect(staff.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('kitchenEmail')); pm.expect(staff.passwordHash).to.eql(undefined); if (staff.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('kitchenStaffId', staff.id); });

item.name: Manager cannot create another Manager as staff

exec: pm.test('staff endpoint rejects Manager role escalation', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

pm.test('manager invite is created once with a fixed role', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const invite = pm.response.json().invite; pm.expect(invite.role).to.eql('WAITER'); pm.expect(invite.code).to.be.a('string'); pm.collectionVariables.set('inviteCode', invite.code); });
pm.test('manager updates scoped staff', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().staff.name).to.eql('Updated Postman Waiter'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('inviteeEmail', `invitee-${Date.now()}@example.test`); pm.collectionVariables.set('inviteePassword', 'VistonaInvite123!');

pm.test('valid invite creates a waiter account and session', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const user = pm.response.json().user; pm.expect(user.role).to.eql('waiter'); pm.expect(user.passwordHash).to.eql(undefined); });

item.name: 04 Waiter
item.description: Login Waiter first. Create a WAITER order before running kitchen transition requests.

exec: pm.test('waiter can read restaurant', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('waiter sees only active tables and gets no manager QR tokens', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.tables).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.tables.every((table) => table.active === true)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.tables.every((table) => table.publicQrToken === undefined)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.menu).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('waiter can update table status', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('waiter can create order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('order is tenant-scoped and has server price', function () { pm.expect(body.order.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.order.amount).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.order.source).to.eql('waiter'); });
if (body.order && body.order.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('waiterOrderId', body.order.id);
pm.test('waiter POS order is forbidden', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('error response is JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });

item.name: 06 Account
item.description: Run account requests while signed in as the user whose profile/password is being tested. Password change signs out current and prior sessions.

exec: pm.test('account details load', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const account = pm.response.json().account; pm.expect(account.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(account.email).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(account.restaurantName).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(account.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(account.passwordHash).to.eql(undefined); });
pm.test('account name can be updated', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().account.name).to.eql('Updated Postman Owner'); });
pm.test('account API does not accept role changes', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('password change succeeds and requires reauthentication', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().reauthenticationRequired).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('password change clears the session cookie', function () { const cookie = pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie') || ''; pm.expect(cookie.toLowerCase()).to.include('max-age=0'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('managerPassword', 'VistonaOwner456!');

item.name: 07 Authorization Tests
item.description: Run these unauthenticated API checks after Logout. Waiter/kitchen role denials are also exercised in their role folders.

exec: pm.test('staff endpoint requires authentication', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('account endpoint requires authentication', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: 08 QR Ordering
item.description: Public table-token endpoints. Create a table in 11 Tables first; table number is derived from its QR token, never from the order body.

exec: pm.test('public QR menu succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('token menu returns its table and active stock states', function () { pm.expect(body.table.number).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('tableNumber')); pm.expect(body.menu).to.be.an('array'); const available = body.menu.find((item) => item.available); pm.expect(available, 'at least one in-stock item is needed for an order').to.exist; if (available) pm.collectionVariables.set('menuItemId', available.id); });
pm.test('public QR order is created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('server marks source QR', function () { pm.expect(body.order.source).to.eql('qr'); pm.expect(body.order.id).to.be.a('string'); });
if (body.order && body.order.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('qrOrderId', body.order.id);
pm.test('customer cannot override QR table number', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

item.name: 09 Orders
item.description: Manager workflow. Create the order first, then run each transition in order. GET returns only the active session's tenant/restaurant orders.

exec: pm.test('orders read succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().orders).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('since filter succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().orders).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('invalid since is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('manager can create POS order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('order uses persisted price and has ID', function () { pm.expect(body.order.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.order.amount).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.order.source).to.eql('pos'); });
if (body.order && body.order.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('orderId', body.order.id);
pm.test('NEW to PREPARING succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('preparing'); });
pm.test('PREPARING to READY succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('ready'); });
pm.test('READY to SERVED succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('served'); });
pm.test('SERVED to COMPLETED succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().order.status).to.eql('completed'); });

item.name: 10 Menu
item.description: Manager-only menu CRUD and stock controls. Categories are created/reused within the current restaurant. Removal is soft and preserves order snapshots.

exec: pm.test('manager reads active menu including out-of-stock items', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.categories).to.be.an('array'); });

body.raw:
{
  "name": "{{menuDishName}}",
  "description": "Postman menu dish",

}

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('menuDishName', `Postman Dish ${Date.now()}`);

pm.test('manager creates dish in current restaurant', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const item = pm.response.json().item; pm.expect(item.name).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('menuDishName')); pm.expect(item.price).to.eql(175); pm.expect(item.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(item.tenantId).to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(item.restaurantId).to.eql(undefined); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdMenuItemId', item.id); });

item.name: Edit dish without creating a duplicate

exec: pm.test('manager edits existing menu item', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const item = pm.response.json().item; pm.expect(item.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('createdMenuItemId')); pm.expect(item.price).to.eql(185); pm.expect(item.category).to.eql('Main Course'); });
pm.test('manager toggles item out of stock', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().item.available).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('backend rejects out-of-stock menu item', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test('manager restores item', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().item.available).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 11 Tables
item.description: Run while signed in as MANAGER. Create captures the server table ID and stable QR token; edit and remove are scoped to the authenticated restaurant. Waiters can read active tables and update status only.

exec: pm.test('manager gets restaurant tables', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().tables).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('tableNumber', `P${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`);

pm.test('manager creates a table in the current restaurant', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const table = pm.response.json().table; pm.expect(table.number).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('tableNumber')); pm.expect(table.seats).to.eql(4); pm.expect(table.active).to.eql(true); pm.expect(table.publicQrToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(table.tenantId).to.eql(undefined); pm.expect(table.restaurantId).to.eql(undefined); pm.collectionVariables.set('tableId', table.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('tableQrToken', table.publicQrToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('tableQrUrl', `${pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl')}/menu/${pm.collectionVariables.get('restaurantSlug')}/table/${table.publicQrToken}`); });
pm.test('duplicate restaurant table number returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });

pm.test('manager edits table within current restaurant', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const table = pm.response.json().table; pm.expect(table.number).to.eql(`${pm.collectionVariables.get('tableNumber')}-E`); pm.expect(table.seats).to.eql(6); pm.expect(table.publicQrToken).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('tableQrToken')); pm.collectionVariables.set('tableNumber', table.number); });
pm.test('manager can update table status', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().table.status).to.eql('AVAILABLE'); });
pm.test('manager can mark table occupied', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: Deactivate table without deleting order history

exec: pm.test('table is safely deactivated', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const table = pm.response.json().table; pm.expect(table.active).to.eql(false); pm.expect(table.publicQrToken).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('tableQrToken')); });

item.name: 14 Payments
item.description: Existing payment handlers have no session auth. Create-order contacts Razorpay and needs valid server environment configuration plus an unpaid orderId. Never place provider secrets in this collection.

item.name: Create Razorpay order for database order

exec: pm.test('Razorpay order request succeeds when configured', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('provider response contains payment order details', function () { pm.expect(body.razorpayOrderId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.amount).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.currency).to.eql('INR'); });
if (body.razorpayOrderId) pm.collectionVariables.set('razorpayOrderId', body.razorpayOrderId);
pm.test('invalid checkout signature is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('invalid webhook signature is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
